attributes.title: SEPA 73rd Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Southeastern Psychological Association holds its 73rd Annual Meeting from April 7 to 10, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Greenville in Greenville, South Carolina. SEPA is one of the regional psychological associations, and its meeting mixes research talks, posters and invited addresses with a continuing education track for practicing psychologists.

SEPA is approved by the American Psychological Association to sponsor continuing education for psychologists. CE is sold separately from registration through the Raymond D. Fowler Continuing Education Program: workshops run from one to six hours ($30 for one hour up to $120 for six hours), and selected invited addresses carry one hour of credit for $30. How many hours you earn depends on the sessions you book.

Professional members pay $115 in advance registration through March 3, 2027, and $170 on site; non-member professionals pay $185 in advance and $235 on site. Students pay $95 (member) or $165 (non-member) in advance. Member dues must be current as of September 1, 2026, to get the member rate.
